definitions.short: a basis (of a building, a column, etc.)
definitions.full: H134. eden [ אֶ֫דֶן ] 57 noun masculine Exod 26:19 base, pedestal — אָ֑דֶן 38:7 ; plural אֲדָנִים 26:19 +; construct אַדְנֵי Song 5:15 +, etc. 1 pedestals of fine gold, on which pillars of marble were set Song 5:15 . 2 pedestals of the earth on which its pillars were placed Job 38:6 (|| corner-stone). 3 (metal) pedestals, bases , or sockets in which tenons of planks & pillars of tabernacle were set up; two for each plank & one for each pillar Exod 26:19 (3 t. in verse) + 52 t. in Exodus 26, 27, 35-40 Numbers 3, 4 (all P); compare ᵐ5 Sm Co for אָרְכּוֺ Ezek 41:22 , of altar.
